items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Matches TC3.2 (trg-c0d83dce) scope: a small coverage-declaration check wired into the spec.md mandated-load instruction in shipwright-iterate and shipwright-project; decision_log.md wording is untouched (that is TC3.2a / #608, dismissed separately).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing files report exists:false instead of raising; file reads use errors="replace"; no external service calls.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL/HTML output, no secrets; paths are project-root-relative globs supplied by the calling skill, same trust level as resolve_model_tier.py.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 13 tests assert on outcomes (dict shapes, exit codes): within-cap, over-cap, exact-cap, missing file, aggregate flag, custom cap, empty input, CLI glob expansion / no-match / explicit path.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single-pass line count per file, no N+1, no unbounded output (one row per input path).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: lib/tool pair mirrors resolve_model_tier.py's shape; both new files well under 300 LOC.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: CLI output is a printed JSON report consumed inline by the invoking skill step, not a persisted artifact another script parses back -- no producer/consumer round-trip to test.
